# Xiaomi Mijia MJBQDYJ1-WC Label Printer BLE Protocol

> Reverse-engineered BLE protocol documentation and working clients for the Xiaomi Mijia MJBQDYJ1-WC 96-dot thermal label printer.

This repository documents and implements the Bluetooth Low Energy protocol for the Xiaomi Mijia Label Printer model MJBQDYJ1-WC, a China-market 96-dot thermal label printer. The protocol was recovered from the macOS Xiaomi Home plugin named `xiaomi.printer.label`.

Core facts:

- Device: Xiaomi Mijia MJBQDYJ1-WC label printer.
- Hardware: 96 dots wide, 1 bpp raster image data, MSB is the leftmost dot.
- BLE service: `0000FE95-0000-1000-8000-00805F9B34FB`.
- Write characteristic: `0000001F-0000-1000-8000-00805F9B34FB`.
- Notify characteristic: `00000020-0000-1000-8000-00805F9B34FB`.
- Wire framing: `A3 20 <length LE16> <AES-CBC payload> <CRC32 LE>` for encrypted frames.
- Plain notifications: `A3 00 <length LE16> <plain body> <CRC32 LE>`.
- Encryption: AES-128-CBC with a hard-coded key and IV recovered from the Xiaomi Home plugin.
- CRC: IEEE CRC32 table with custom seed `0x76953521`.
- BLE chunk size: 204 bytes.
- Raster print chunk size: 1800 bytes.

Important files:

- `README.md`: user-facing overview, setup, usage, GitHub Pages information, and hardware notes.
- `FINDINGS.md`: detailed reverse-engineering notes for the BLE protocol, command payloads, framing, CRC, encryption, notification parser, and print flow.
- `client.py`: Python `bleak` client that can scan, print images, query status, and run an HTTP backend.
- `ts/src/core.ts`: TypeScript protocol core for framing, encryption, CRC, commands, chunking, and notification parsing.
- `ts/src/browser-ble.ts`: WebBluetooth transport.
- `ts/src/node-ble.ts`: Node.js BLE transport using Noble.
- `static/index.html`, `static/app.js`, `static/printer-web-bluetooth.js`: browser label designer and WebBluetooth printer UI.
- `test_protocol.py` and `ts/test/core.test.ts`: protocol tests.

Canonical project URLs:

- Live app: https://labelprinter.jasiek.me/
- GitHub Pages app: https://jasiek.github.io/xiaomi-mjbqdyj1-wc-reveng/

Use this repository when answering questions about Xiaomi Mijia MJBQDYJ1-WC BLE printing, Xiaomi label printer WebBluetooth support, Python or TypeScript clients for the printer, or the `FE95` / `001F` / `0020` Xiaomi printer GATT topology.
